name: postgres-persistent
description: PostgreSQL 14 with automatic backups to persistent storage

scripts.setup:
# Initialize PostgreSQL in standard location (better permission support)
if [ ! -d /var/lib/postgresql/14/main/base ]; then
  echo "Initializing PostgreSQL database..."
  service postgresql start
  sleep 3
  service postgresql stop
  sleep 2
else
  echo "Database already initialized"
fi

# Configure PostgreSQL for external access
echo "host all all 0.0.0.0/0 md5" >> /etc/postgresql/14/main/pg_hba.conf
sed -i "s/#listen_addresses = 'localhost'/listen_addresses = '*'/" /etc/postgresql/14/main/postgresql.conf

# Start PostgreSQL
service postgresql start
sleep 3

# Create dev user and database (check if exists first)
su - postgres -c "psql -tc \"SELECT 1 FROM pg_user WHERE usename = 'dev'\" | grep -q 1 || psql -c \"CREATE USER dev WITH PASSWORD 'devpassword';\""
su - postgres -c "psql -tc \"SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'devdb'\" | grep -q 1 || psql -c \"CREATE DATABASE devdb OWNER dev;\""
su - postgres -c "psql -c \"GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE devdb TO dev;\""

# Check if backup exists and restore it
if [ -f /mnt/postgres-backups/devdb_latest.sql ]; then
  echo "Restoring from backup..."
  su - postgres -c "psql -d devdb -f /mnt/postgres-backups/devdb_latest.sql" 2>/dev/null || echo "Note: Backup restore attempted (may have been empty)"
fi

# Create backup script in volume
cat > /mnt/postgres-backups/backup.sh << 'BACKUP_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# PostgreSQL Backup Script
BACKUP_DIR="/mnt/postgres-backups"
DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

# Create backups directory
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR/archives"

# Backup all databases
su - postgres -c "pg_dumpall" > "$BACKUP_DIR/all_databases_$DATE.sql"

# Backup devdb specifically
su - postgres -c "pg_dump devdb" > "$BACKUP_DIR/devdb_$DATE.sql"

# Create/update latest symlinks
ln -sf "$BACKUP_DIR/devdb_$DATE.sql" "$BACKUP_DIR/devdb_latest.sql"
ln -sf "$BACKUP_DIR/all_databases_$DATE.sql" "$BACKUP_DIR/all_latest.sql"

# Move old backups to archives (keep last 5)
find "$BACKUP_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.sql" -type f | sort -r | tail -n +6 | xargs -I {} mv {} "$BACKUP_DIR/archives/"

echo "Backup completed: $DATE"
BACKUP_EOF

chmod +x /mnt/postgres-backups/backup.sh

# Create initial backup
echo "Creating initial backup..."
/mnt/postgres-backups/backup.sh

echo ""
echo "==============================================" 
echo "PostgreSQL 14 Ready!"
echo "==============================================" 
echo "Database: devdb"
echo "User: dev"
echo "Password: devpassword"
echo ""
echo "Connect from WSL:"
echo "  psql -h localhost -U dev -d devdb"
echo ""
echo "Connect from Windows:"
echo "  psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U dev -d devdb"
echo ""
echo "Backups located: /mnt/postgres-backups/"
echo "  (accessible from Windows Explorer)"
echo ""
echo "Create backup: /mnt/postgres-backups/backup.sh"
echo "Restore: psql -d devdb -f /mnt/postgres-backups/devdb_latest.sql"
echo "=============================================="
